name: IGDB
tagline: Twitch-backed video game database API (games, platforms, covers, search)
description: IGDB (Internet Game Database) is a free REST API for comprehensive video game metadata: titles, platforms, genres, companies, covers, screenshots, release dates, characters, and more. Queries use the Apicalypse body language (fields, where, search, sort, limit). Auth is Twitch OAuth2 client-credentials: register a Confidential app, exchange Client ID/Secret for an app access token, then send Client-ID and Authorization: Bearer on every POST to https://api.igdb.com/v4.

auth.details: Twitch Developer Console Confidential app → Client ID + Client Secret. POST https://id.twitch.tv/oauth2/token?client_id=...&client_secret=...&grant_type=client_credentials for app access token. Every IGDB request needs headers Client-ID and Authorization: Bearer <token> (token ~60 days).

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free for non-commercial and commercial use (FAQ); no published request quota. Rate limit only: 4 req/s, up to 8 concurrent open requests. Commercial use expects partnership/attribution (partner@igdb.com).
pricing.paid_plans: No paid tiers; commercial free under partnership (attribution to IGDB.com).

rate_limits: 4 requests per second; up to 8 open concurrent requests; 429 Too Many Requests when exceeded.

example.request: curl -X POST 'https://api.igdb.com/v4/games' -H 'Client-ID: YOUR_CLIENT_ID' -H 'Authorization: Bearer YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN' -H 'Accept: application/json' -d 'fields name; limit 10;'
example.response_snippet: [{"id":1,"name":"Thief II: The Metal Age"},{"id":2,"name":"Thief: The Dark Project"},{"id":3,"name":"Thief: Deadly Shadows"}]

use_cases: search games by name and return IDs, titles, and release dates
look up a game by ID for summary, genres, platforms, and rating
list upcoming or recent releases for a platform (e.g. PlayStation)
fetch cover or screenshot image IDs for a game library UI
resolve involved companies (developers/publishers) for a title
search characters, collections, platforms, or themes across IGDB
